residuals.detail: Live stitched capture (taken with --settle, ~25 s timeline) lands on a later slide whose visible set includes the 600 px review; the prototype is captured at t≈2 s on slide 1. Height delta 200 px @1440 / 28 px @360 is this state alone: settled-sections at the same timeline gives 9074 = 9074 @1440 and identical section heights except the carousel. Behaviour mirrored exactly (Museum @6.5 s, Art @12.5 s on both).

The live theme hides every section between hero and footer until an IntersectionObserver adds animate-fadeIn/fadeInY; stitch-shot pauses animations, so both captures show those bands blank. Pixel fidelity of those sections was checked with the supplementary forced-visible capture (stardust/replica/tools/reveal-shot.mjs) and box-by-box (anchor/measure: every section y/h equal). At 360 the live settle pass restarts the first split's fade-in (hidden on live, visible on build): band 1000–1500 23% — instrument asymmetry, not a defect.
Consent tool not migrated (dynamics decision D-3); live tab visible in capture only.
